# init

Create an empty git repository.

## JavaScript

```ts
git.init({ bare?: boolean, quiet?: boolean, initialBranch?: string, directory?: string })
```

## CLI

```bash
git --no-pager init [--bare] [--quiet] [--initial-branch <initial-branch>] [<directory>]
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bare` | `--bare` | `boolean` | No | - | Create a bare repository. |
| `quiet` | `--quiet` | `boolean` | No | - | Suppress informational output. |
| `initialBranch` | `--initial-branch` | `string` | No | - | Name of the initial branch. |
| `directory` | _positional_ | `string` | No | - | Directory to initialise. |

## Examples

**Initialise a repository in ./tmp**

```ts
await git.init({
  directory: './tmp',
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager init ./tmp
```
